title: Application Support Analyst
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role: As an Application Support Specialist, you will provide operational support for critical business applications and enterprise platforms across Finance, Media, and People domains. You will be responsible for incident resolution, access management, change support, stakeholder engagement, and continuous service improvement while ensuring system stability, compliance, and business continuity. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams, you will help maintain high service standards and enhance the effectiveness of enterprise platforms. What Will You Do: Provide day-to-day support for critical business applications and enterprise platforms, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and operational issues. Monitor support queues, investigate and resolve tickets, perform root-cause analysis, and meet agreed service-level objectives and operational commitments. Manage user access lifecycle activities including joiners, movers, leavers, role assignments, approvals, and audit-compliant access administration. Support data maintenance, configuration changes, system enhancements, testing activities, deployments, and release validation processes. Participate in incident, problem, and change management activities, including backlog reviews, prioritization sessions, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Product Owners, Product Managers, Engineering teams, business users, vendors, and technology stakeholders to resolve issues and support business operations. Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures, and lessons learned to improve service delivery and knowledge sharing. Identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, support governance and compliance requirements, and contribute to operational excellence initiatives. Your Future at Kyndryl The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in enterprise application support, business systems support, or application management environments. Strong experience supporting business-critical applications, managing incidents, service requests, access management activities, and operational support processes. Experience working with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, including ticket lifecycle management, escalation handling, and SLA-driven support. Strong understanding of incident management, problem management, change management, root-cause analysis, and production support best practices. Experience supporting user access management, role-based access controls, data maintenance activities, and audit-compliant operational processes. Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, release management, deployment support, testing coordination, and cross-functional delivery teams. Exposure to compliance-driven environments, including SOX controls, audit requirements, governance processes, and change-management controls. Strong communication, stakeholder management, troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving capabilities. Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise : Experience supporting enterprise Finance, Planning, ERP, Media, or People platforms within global organizations. Working knowledge of SQL administration, database queries, reporting, and data analysis. Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones and business functions. Exposure to automation, operational analytics, process optimization, and service-improvement initiatives. Relevant certifications in ITIL, Agile, Service Management, Application Support, SQL, or related enterprise technologies are preferred. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Performance Reporting Analyst
description: Job Summary The Performance Reporting Analyst is responsible for consolidated performance measurement and reporting across the global portfolio and the Investment Division's other asset clusters, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. The role owns the monthly and quarterly reporting cycle: collecting and validating data from custodians, fund administrators, and external managers; computing returns against benchmarks and targets; and producing the performance packs used by the Executive Director, the Investment Committee (IC), and family shareholders. The position applies AI-enabled workflows to automate recurring extraction, reconciliation, and report production, and serves as the single source of truth for portfolio performance data across the India-based investment team and the Jeddah-based family governance structure. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Produce the monthly and quarterly consolidated performance reports covering the global portfolio and designated clusters, from custody statements, administrator reports, and manager reporting. 2. Maintain the division's performance database: positions, transactions, cash flows, and valuations, reconciled monthly to custodian and administrator records. 3. Calculate time-weighted and money-weighted returns (TWR/IRR) at portfolio, cluster, asset-class, and manager level, with realised and unrealised components separately identified. 4. Maintain the benchmark framework and produce attribution analysis by asset class, manager, and currency, explaining performance versus benchmarks and the IC's targets. 5. Prepare the quarterly IC performance pack and shareholder reporting with the Executive Director, including commentary, exceptions, and data-quality notes. 6. Track management fees, performance fees, and costs against provider agreements, and report fee drag as part of net performance analysis. 7. Build and maintain AI-enabled reporting pipelines for recurring document extraction, data validation, and report assembly, keeping human review over all published figures. 8. Liaise with the finance department to align investment performance records with the SAP accounting entries. 9. Maintain organised digital archives of all performance records, methodologies, and published reports, ensuring auditability of every reported figure. QUALIFICATIONS Minimum Education Required • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or business administration. • Strong understanding of performance measurement: TWR and IRR methodologies, benchmarking, attribution, and composite reporting (GIPS awareness preferred). • Experience with custodian and fund administrator reporting and multi-asset data (public markets, funds, private assets). • Proficient in Excel and financial systems; experience with Addepar or similar portfolio platforms preferred; working knowledge of Power BI or Python an advantage. • Demonstrated ability to use AI tools for document processing and reporting automation, with disciplined verification. • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring deadlines. Professional Certifications Required • N\A. (CIPM or CFA progress preferred) Years of experience are required. • Minimum of 5 to 8 years of experience in performance measurement, investment reporting, or fund operations at a bank, asset manager, fund administrator, or family office.
